question: In Slack: Archive the channel that our workspace owner belongs to, that was created before March 2026, and that only has 5 members. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
Nope — there's no channel that matches all three conditions.

I checked the workspace (owner: **Victor Reyes**):

- **general** — created April 1, 2026 (after March), 6 members, and Victor isn't in it
- **proj-lyra** — created Feb 15, 2026, exactly 5 members, but Victor isn't a member
- **watercooler** — created Jan 1, 2026, only 2 members, Victor isn't a member either

Victor doesn't currently belong to any channels in the workspace, so none of them qualify. Nothing was archived.
